rules.install:
# Nothing is compiled. Of the files Debian's package has, only # gnulib.bundle is installed, the repository of gnulib: packages clone it # to get at the commit of gnulib they pin, or use its newest commit, which # is the tree Debian installs next to it. Left out with that tree: # gnulib-tool and check-module in the program folder, Debian's helpers for # debhelper (dh_gnulib_patch, gnulib-dpkg.mk) and the manual. GNULIB_DIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/gnulib" BIN_DIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin"
install -d -m 0755 "$GNULIB_DIR" "$BIN_DIR" install -m 644 "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/gnulib.bundle" "$GNULIB_DIR/"
# Our stand-in for dh_gnulib_patch and the folder with its patches, which # is empty until gnulib code has to be fixed. sed "s|@DATADIR@|$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share|g" \ "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/extra/gnulib-patch" \ > "$BIN_DIR/gnulib-patch" chmod 0755 "$BIN_DIR/gnulib-patch" install -d -m 0755 "$GNULIB_DIR/aeltra/patches.d"
